label: UNDERSTANDING HIM

cover.headline: Red flags *worth taking seriously*
cover.sub: 5 signs to trust, not explain away.

points.heading: He keeps you from your people
points.body: Pulling you away from friends and family is a warning sign.
points.panel: “Do I see my friends less since we met?”

points.heading: Jealousy that feels like control
points.body: Checking your phone or demanding to know where you are.
points.panel: “Do I feel watched rather than trusted?”

points.heading: Your no isn’t respected
points.body: If he pushes after you’ve said no, that matters, even about small things.
points.panel: “Does he accept my no without a fight?”

points.heading: You feel scared of his reactions
points.body: Walking on eggshells isn’t normal in a loving relationship.
points.panel: “Do I change what I say to avoid his anger?”

points.heading: Big apologies, same behavior
points.body: Big apologies without real change can turn into a pattern.
points.panel: Watch what he does after the apology, not just what he says.

close.save: Save this and trust your gut.

caption:
After a breakup, it’s common to wonder what you missed, or to worry about missing something next time.

These five red flags are worth taking seriously, not explaining away. Your instincts matter. If something feels wrong, you deserve to listen to that feeling and talk to someone you trust.

Save this and trust your gut, and follow @roundabloom for more.
